lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is approximately equidistant across the mid-lateral torso with higher density in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most line segment is abbreviated and terminates mid-shoulder. Posterior-most line segment terminates before reaching the mid-vertical height of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5-6 white spots localized on the lower posterior haunch near the hind limb junction.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 3 distinct spots is visible across the mid-thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking on the nasal bridge, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek area, and a large white patch on the lower ventral neck.
